newsitem.title: DUBAI: Sharjah air cargo volumes rise 26 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Sharjah air cargo volumes rise 26 pct in June.

text.p: Sharjah airport said cargo volumes rose 26 percent in June to 30,494 tonnes from 24,152 tonnes in the same month last year.
The figure was slightly lower than the 30,625 tonnes handled in May this year.

Most of the June total came from transferred freight of 11,560 tonnes. This reflects the hubbing operations of airlines such as, where cargo is often brought in on one aircraft and transferred to another.
Exports from Sharjah in June totalled 9,851 tonnes. Moscow was the biggest destination, taking about 3,120 tonnes of Sharjah exports. About 930 tonnes went to Tashkent in the month.
The emirate imported 1,162 tonnes of goods through its airport in June, versus 761 tonnes in May. Freight in transit in the month was 7,921 tonnes.
Sea-air freight exports rose 19 percent to 3,037 tonnes from 2,544 tonnes in June 1996.
There were 1,389 scheduled and 853 charter flights, versus a respective 1,194 and 834 in the same month last year.
In June 1997, 71,889 passengers passed through Sharjah airport compared to 68,394 the year before.
